SELECT 'members' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS total FROM members
UNION ALL SELECT 'devices', COUNT(*) FROM devices
UNION ALL SELECT 'messages', COUNT(*) FROM messages
UNION ALL SELECT 'app_config', COUNT(*) FROM app_config
UNION ALL SELECT 'catalog_releases', COUNT(*) FROM catalog_releases
UNION ALL SELECT 'download_jobs', COUNT(*) FROM download_jobs
UNION ALL SELECT 'device_downloads', COUNT(*) FROM device_downloads
